title: Compare Ratio Relationships
focus: Compare ratios using tables, graphs, and scaling

items.stem: Which of the following ratios is equivalent to 3:5?
A recipe calls for 4 cups of flour for every 7 cups of sugar. If you use 12 cups of flour, how many cups of sugar do you need to keep the same ratio?
Select ALL pairs of ratios that are equivalent.

A table shows the ratio of hours worked to amount earned as follows: | Hours Worked | Amount Earned ($) | |--|-| | 3 | 45 | | 6 | 90 | | 9 | 135 | Explain whether the ratios in the table are equivalent and show or explain your work to support your answer.
